{{Otheruses|Deep Core}}
The '''''Deep Core''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used to carry equipment for the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] during her [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] tour. The cargo was split between the ''Deep Core'' and the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3500|PLY-3500]] ''[[Nova's Heart]]'', with each [[Starship/Legends|ship]] carrying enough equipment for her to continue to perform if something were to happen to the other vessel.
